items.title: 不存在的罪人
items.overview: 改编自科琳·胡佛的同名小说。知名作家维莉蒂·克劳福德因意外受伤后，洛温·阿什利受聘代笔完成她的系列小说，并搬进克劳福德家中。洛温意外发现维莉蒂令人不安的自传手稿，逐渐陷入真假难辨的秘密、操纵与执念之中。

items.title: 泥面人
items.overview: 好莱坞新星马特·哈根遭犯罪头目毁容后，为恢复容貌接受先进治疗，却意外陷入疯狂，走上复仇之路。

items.title: 末世行者
items.overview: 改编自彼得·海勒的同名小说。在残酷的末世中，年轻飞行员希格与军事生存专家班格利建立了一个与世隔绝的居所。当一段神秘的无线电信号传来，希格决定踏入未知世界，寻找他仍然相信存在的希望与人性。

items.title: 忘却之岛
items.overview: 好友乔与拉伊萨高中毕业即将分别，她们打算相伴度过最后一夜，却意外被传送到奇幻岛屿纳卡利。二人得知重返家园的代价是抹去关于彼此的全部记忆，她们必须抓紧时间，在遗忘对方找到方法离开这座岛屿。

items.title: 天启Z：新世界
items.overview: 致命TSJ病毒摧毁人类文明，加那利群岛侥幸躲过灾难，成为欧洲大陆幸存者最后的庇护所。一支小队受命重返危机四伏的伊比利亚半岛执行补给任务，心存私心的罗伯托加入队伍。任务迅速演变为一场残酷的生存竞速，小队要在丧尸潮与内部立场分裂的夹缝中挣扎求生，所有人都要直面终极抉择：保全自己，还是冒着一切风险守护残存的人类文明。

items.title: 荒野丛林
items.overview: 普鲁和同班同学柯蒂斯误入一片禁忌魔法森林，林中遍布魔法生灵、忠心伙伴与强大劲敌。二人踏上一场凶险万分的营救之旅，要从神秘女子亚历山德拉统领的鸦群手中，救出被掳走的婴儿弟弟麦克。

items.title: 复仇者联盟5
items.overview: 来自三个截然不同宇宙的传奇英雄们，将被推向一场生死对决，并最终直面一股前所未见、足以撼动万物存亡的终极威胁。

profile.tagline: 选择皆有代价，毁灭将至，终局未定。

items.title: 我们接纳的女孩
items.overview: 霍普收养了长期担任家中保姆的16岁女孩索菲，却逐渐怀疑这个新女儿隐藏着一个可怕的秘密，可能危及整个家庭。

items.title: 希望
items.overview: 支援人员前往扑救山火，通讯也随之中断。湖浦派出所所长范锡与警员成爱奋力保护村中老人，而进入山中追踪怪物的成基等人反遭猎杀。由无知引发的灾难逐渐演变为一场席卷宇宙的悲剧.

related.title: 疯狂的麦克斯4：狂暴之路

items.title: Ali G: 我系水？
items.overview: 消失在公众视野二十年后，阿里·G惊讶地发现，长期交往的女友朱莉已经怀孕八个月。为了养活即将出生的孩子，他动身前往美国，试图重振昔日声名，却遭遇一群可能威胁他和孩子性命的对手。

items.overview: 一名失踪36年的男子尸体在一桩骇人命案现场被发现，他的女儿梅格由此追查父亲隐秘的黑暗过往。

items.title: 痴迷
items.overview: 性格孤僻的小镇青年贝尔（迈克尔·约翰斯顿 饰）苦苦暗恋女神妮基（印达·纳瓦雷特 饰）却怯于表白。他在一家商店意外获得神秘许愿道具 “一愿柳”，折断柳条许下 “让妮基爱我胜过世上所有人” 的愿望。愿望成真后，妮基却逐渐失控，变得痴缠癫狂，对贝尔产生窒息般的控制欲，身体、人格与理智接连崩塌。这场强求来的 “爱情” 暗藏致命代价，将贝尔拖入万劫不复的深渊。

profile.tagline: 许愿需谨慎

items.title: 极速：伪装者
items.overview: 一位年轻的赛车技师假装与赛车界最具争议的的明星车手订婚，表面上是为了维护他的名声，实则是为了自己能有机会成为赛车手。但很快，这个谎言就威胁到一切，包括这段早已超越单纯交易的感情…

items.title: 失控撞劫
items.overview: 2013年，西班牙。抢劫银行后，逃离现场时发生的事故暴露出每个盗贼隐藏的一面，揭开了早在抢劫前就已开始的背叛和谎言。

items.overview: 改编自弗兰克·赫伯特的科幻小说《沙丘2：沙丘救世主》。保罗·厄崔迪夺取帝国统治权近二十年后，成为冷酷的皇帝。面对旧盟友回归、新威胁浮现与暗中背叛，保罗深陷一场阴谋，并必须直面权力的代价与所爱之人的命运。

profile.tagline: 命运已至，终章降临。

items.overview: 彼得·帕克以蜘蛛侠的身份全职打击犯罪，但在一个无人记得他的世界里，看着昔日好友各自开启新生活的压力，正引发他无法掌控的变化。而这场蜕变，或许也是阻止威胁城市及他所爱之人的强大隐形反派的唯一希望。

profile.tagline: 纵使被遗忘，依然在守护。

items.overview: 高端特种押运员汉克·马龙必须在三小时内，将一颗肝脏从洛杉矶国际机场运往圣巴巴拉的一家医院，用于一台紧急移植手术。受赠者是一名濒危的七岁女孩，她拥有全球极为罕见的血型。偏偏南加州最危险犯罪集团的头目，也急需这颗器官。

items.title: 理智与情感
items.overview: 改编自简·奥斯汀的同名经典名著。乔治亚时期英格兰，达什伍德先生去世后，遗孀与三名女儿失去庄园继承权，被迫迁居乡间简陋房屋。长女埃莉诺与次女玛丽安在拮据处境与社会压力下各自面对求婚、心碎与对真爱的探寻。

items.title: 生化危机：爆发夜
items.overview: 奉命奔赴浣熊市的医疗速递员布莱恩，意外深陷全城失控的病毒浩劫。浣熊市彻底沦陷，异变怪物横行肆虐、嗜血猎捕，身陷末日绝境的他，能否在这场惊魂噩梦中突围求生，搏出一线生机？

items.title: 奥德赛
items.overview: 改编自荷马史诗《奥德赛》。特洛伊战争结束后，伊萨卡国王奥德修斯历经艰险、踏上漫长归乡之旅。

profile.tagline: 违抗神明，逆天而行。

items.title: Lupin
items.overview: 灵感源自莫里斯·勒布朗创作的亚森·罗宾系列小说。绅士怪盗阿桑·迪奥普受到亚森·罗宾冒险的启发，凭借智慧与魅力智胜敌人，保护所爱之人。

items.title: 末路兼职
items.overview:
为摆脱沉重的债务压力，革浚被一张奇怪的传单吸引，上面写着一份“高薪兼职工作”。循着传单上的信息，他来到神秘的“蜘蛛人力事务所”。这里的时薪起步就是最低工资的 50 倍，但有一条铁律：绝不能透露工作期间发生的任何事情。

革浚被派往一家看似普通的便利店，却很快发现，在这个宛如噩梦般的职场里，每一次值班都可能让他丧命。

items.title: 幻视任务
items.overview: 重启后的幻视隐居避世，试图摆脱将他武器化的人，并通过与体内的AI人格交流寻找存在意义，其中包括恶名昭彰的奥创。然而高额悬赏打破了平静，他被迫与神秘少年托马斯·谢泼德一同逃亡，后者或许是他重生后的儿子。

items.title: MobLand
items.overview: 两大黑帮家族的权力争斗将伦敦地下世界卷入战争。作为哈里根家族的“解决者”，哈里·达·索萨周旋于家族、敌人和日益失控的内部矛盾之间。

items.title: 嗜血法医：杀魔复生
items.overview: 德克斯特·摩根从昏迷中醒来，发现哈里森不知所踪。意识到自己对儿子造成的伤害，德克斯特启程前往纽约，决心找到哈里森，弥补过失。但最终的结局并非易事。迈阿密地铁的安吉尔·巴蒂斯塔带着疑问前来，德克斯特意识到自己的过去正迅速地追上自己。父子俩在这座不夜城里摸索着各自的黑暗，很快发现自己陷入了比想象中更深的困境——而唯一的出路就是携手共进。

profile.tagline: 他还活着，而且表现超神。

items.title: 夜行杀机
items.overview: 恶名昭彰的连环杀手尤里克·沃尔特的一名受害者意外生还，警探乔纳·林分秒必争务求找出唯一仍然失踪的人，同时他的徒弟萨加·鲍尔则充当卧底，试图从杀手身上获得答案。

related.title: 好女孩的谋杀调查报告

items.title: 死神
items.overview: 高中生黑崎一护意外获得死神之力，从此卷入现世、尸魂界与虚圈之间的纷争。在守护同伴的战斗中，他逐渐揭开自己的身世，并迎来决定三界命运的最终决战。

items.title: The Terminal List
items.overview: 改编自杰克·卡尔的系列小说。海豹突击队队长詹姆斯·里斯在一次秘密任务后卷入重重阴谋。从军事行动到国际谍战，他在追寻真相与执行任务的过程中，逐步揭开隐藏在背后的危险势力。

profile.tagline: 你的记忆让你怀疑真相。

items.overview: 夜之城每一季都有新故事，也总有一群特立独行的新角色登场，讲述属于他们的传奇。

profile.tagline: 只管奔跑

items.title: 魔女嘉莉
items.overview: 父亲的突然离世迫使嘉莉进入到了残酷的公立高中，她不得不面对席卷社区的校园霸凌丑闻、社交媒体时代无情的压力和冷酷无情，以及伴随青春期而觉醒的神秘心灵感应能力。

items.title: Dark Matter
items.overview: 平行世界的出现，让不同的人生与现实彼此交错。杰森、丹妮拉、阿曼达、瑞恩等人被卷入其中，在无数种可能的人生之间寻找自己的归宿，也重新面对选择、家庭、欲望与真正想要的人生。

profile.tagline: 大千寰宇，不及吾家。

items.title: 塔尔萨之王
items.overview: 纽约黑手党头目德怀特·曼弗雷迪服刑25年后获释，却被组织放逐至俄克拉何马州塔尔萨。他逐步招募一群意想不到的伙伴，在这座陌生城市建立自己的犯罪帝国。

items.title: 完美的谎言
items.overview: 这是一部心理惊悚片，讲述了一男一女对同一段记忆提出截然相反的说法，为了追寻真相而展开激烈冲突的故事。

items.title: 尚公主
items.overview: 剧集讲述了不甘命运的天家嫡女暮晚摇与智谋无双的寒门才俊言尚携手共筑清平天下的故事，在层层爽点中打造极致人设，看乱世惊涛中少年人们搅动风云，奔赴理想。

items.title: 水晶湖
items.overview: 《十三号星期五》系列电影的前传剧集。一年前，单亲母亲帕姆·沃赫斯的年幼儿子杰森在湖中溺亡，她始终无法走出丧子之痛。两名陌生人登门调查她的过去，一连串诡异事件随之发生，令水晶湖镇的居民开始怀疑：帕姆·沃赫斯究竟是什么人？

related.title: 我知道你去年夏天干了什么

items.title: 嫁金钗
items.overview: 改编自笑佳人的同名小说。阿丑因容貌酷似侯府千金，意外成为国公府世子陆濯的冲喜新娘。陆濯苏醒后对她百般提防，另一名与她容貌相同的女子也对她恨之入骨。身处危机四伏的国公府，阿丑步步谋划，逐渐改写命运，并揭开身世之谜。

items.title: 鬼屋欢乐送
items.overview: 一对年轻夫妇搬到梦想的乡间别墅后，发现这儿原来有着一群不同时期的鬼魂，而他们都想把主角二人赶出去。

items.title: 美国恐怖故事
items.overview: 从闹鬼的豪宅到精神病院，从女巫、马戏团到酒店、邪教、末日与外星人，每一季都讲述一个全新的恐怖故事。它不只是制造鬼魂、杀人狂与怪物，更将恐惧藏进家庭、欲望、宗教、政治、疾病与人性之中。看似彼此独立的故事，又通过人物、地点与事件悄然连接，最终构成一个庞大的“美国恐怖宇宙”。

items.overview: 花街出身的药师少女猫猫被拐入后宫做下人，凭借对毒药与药物的丰富知识和敏锐的洞察力，卷入宫中接连发生的疑难事件，并与神秘宦官壬氏一同揭开重重谜团。

items.title: 雅嘎疑云
items.overview: 改编自凯特·桑德勒创作的同名舞台剧，并重新演绎巴巴雅嘎的民间传说。私家侦探拉普来到一座海滨小镇，调查大型渔业企业继承人亨利·朴的失踪案。随着调查深入，他与当地警探卡森及迷人的大学教授凯瑟琳发生冲突，并逐渐陷入充满神秘嫌疑人、隐秘生活与古老魔法的迷局。

items.title: 戴帽子的猫
items.overview: 戴帽子的“猫”一角由比尔·哈德尔配音——展现他那招牌的幽默、独特方式为孩子带来欢乐，带领观众踏上一段奇幻的旅程，进入一个前所未见的世界。 　　在本片中，我们的英雄接下了想像力与灵感研究所有限责任公司迄今最艰钜的任务：为盖比和赛巴斯汀这对姐弟加油打气，他们正为搬到新城镇而苦恼。对这位过去以行事过激而闻名的闯祸精来说，这可能是他证明自己的最后机会……否则他就会失去他的魔法帽！

items.title: 珠穆朗玛：云中彼岸
items.overview: 真实记录登山滑雪运动员吉姆·莫里森于2025年10月成功沿珠穆朗玛峰北坡霍恩拜因雪沟登顶，并成为全球首位在该危险路线完成滑雪速降的历史性壮举。

related.title: 征服14座高峰：凡事皆有可能

items.title: 霹雳英雄：素还真
items.overview: 少年素还真身怀绝艺，初入江湖原想见识广大世界，却因为新结识的好友卷入了险恶的夺权纷争，就连他的老师都因他遭难。

items.title: 白衣逆行者
items.overview: 影片取材自真实事件，76天紧迫与焦灼的记忆，又在眼前重现。 　　灾难之下，城市陷入危机，病毒反复、资源告急，困境加剧。展现危急时刻众生相，有人一往无前奔赴前线，有人在泥沼中奋力生存，也有人倒下，有人坚守。76 天后解封，汽笛划破长空。这段历史，没有人是旁观者，我们都在时代褶皱里彼此托举，共同度过了艰难时刻。

items.title: 试探
items.overview: 为了测试男友丁伯阳对自己的爱，万影策划了一场失踪事件，让丁伯阳陷入短暂的痛苦中。此时，年轻惹火的马娅趁机上位，与丁伯阳光速热恋，激情同居。可马娅不知道的是，打从自己搬进丁伯阳家的一刻起，自己也成为了这场试探游戏的危险玩家之一…

items.title: 我们仅有一次的人生
items.overview: 身患绝症的女火化师黄燕在工作中误将两份骨灰弄错，当她坦白真相，两家人竟都不愿换回，唯有其中一位死者的女儿姚雪相信黄燕，两人结伴踏上疯狂而荒诞的换骨灰之路，重新理解生命，向死而生。

items.title: 夫妻一场
items.overview: 相识于原博的还俗派对时，李欣冉还是位身患抑郁症的女演员。处于人生低谷的俩人一见钟情，他们迅速走到一起，迎来第一个孩子。带着几百万积蓄，他们憧憬着理想生活，却因挥霍和缺乏理财经验，陷入了经济危机。为扭转困境，原博计划在安吉山中创办手碟乐器工厂。青山绿水似乎是他们梦想中的乌托邦。然而，随着第二个孩子的降生，事业夭折，合伙人离开，债务缠身。日常琐碎与经济压力逐渐蚕食了曾经炙热的感情。在深山中，他们爱到一无所有，只剩彼此。

related.title: 安娜·妮可·史密斯：你们不了解我

items.title: 手捧繁星
items.overview: 影片以援疆教师姚思平与学生艾迪娜、斯塔拉的十年命运羁绊为主线，融合温暖治愈与轻度悬疑元素——既有师生相互救赎的动人瞬间，也有年轻人直面人生困境的成长，延续《我的阿勒泰》对“心灵治愈”的探索，兼具情感温度与现实深度。

items.title: 心迷宫之三重罪
items.overview: 一具烧焦的无名尸体被发现，引发邻里间的猜疑。大家都在怀疑小肖杀人，虎子的家人企图认尸躲避恶霸追债，琴儿则借尸体摆脱已无感情的丈夫，此时，又有一场意外发生………随着警方调查，真相逐渐浮现。

items.title: 向阳青春
items.overview: 高中生夏薇零（肖雨晴 饰），长期困在母亲（李颖 饰） 的严密管控里，学业、选择、交友全都被安排妥当。曾经顺从的她，终于在压抑里爆发，逃课、反抗，和好友宋飞（张恒铭 饰）、陆欢（张婧岚 饰）一起，拼命夺回属于自己的空间。母女之间争吵不断，误会层层叠加，那句沉甸甸的 “我都是为了你”，慢慢变成刺伤彼此的利刃。一边是母亲寄托全部人生的期待，一边是女孩想要自主成长的渴望。这场没有赢家的家庭战争，能否找到和解的出口？这是属于无数青春期孩子的挣扎，也是每个家长都要面对的一课。

items.title: 治安官之乡
items.overview: 《烈焰国度》衍生剧。直率的治安官米奇・福克斯驻守埃奇沃特小镇，巡逻侦办罪案，同时兼顾家庭难题。她既要面对有前科、私种大麻的父亲韦斯，也要守护宣誓捍卫的社区，应对持续升级的犯罪危机。

items.title: 烈焰国度
items.overview: Bode Donovan 是一名年轻罪犯，曾经烧毁了他生命中的一切。为寻求救赎，Bode 加入了北加州一项非常规的监狱释放消防计划，在那里他和其他囚犯以及精英消防员合作扑灭不可预测的大规模火势， 这是项高风险、高回报的任务。当 Bode 被分配到他家乡小镇的项目之后， 五年前留下的秘密也逐渐揭开。

items.title: 造雨人
items.overview: 改编自约翰·格里森姆的同名小说。年轻律师鲁迪·贝勒与布鲁瑟·斯通、迪克·希夫莱特联手，在复杂的法律纠纷中挑战强大势力，揭露案件背后的阴谋，在法庭上为委托人争取正义。

items.title: 警察世家：波士顿
items.overview: 《警察世家：波士顿》是由CBS制作的制作的剧集，讲述前纽约警局探员丹尼·里根在一起涉及其小儿子肖恩的案件后，转而加入波士顿警局。他与莉娜·西尔弗搭档——她出身当地著名警察世家，是家中长女，也是前途无量的“明日之星”。她的祖父彼得斯牧师是波士顿一所历史悠久的浸信会教堂里颇具声望的宗教领袖；他同时是波士顿地区检察官梅·西尔弗的父亲，以及警局总监莎拉·西尔弗（最初称为阿什莉）和新晋巡警乔纳·西尔弗（最初称为艾萨克）的外祖父。
items.episode_title: Everything Right Can Still Be Wrong

items.title: 古战场传奇：吾血之亲
items.overview: 《古战场传奇：吾血之亲》是《古战场传奇》的前传。讲述杰米·弗雷泽和克莱尔·博尚的父母在不同时代的爱情故事。18世纪的苏格兰高地，艾伦与布莱恩冲破家族阻碍相爱；20世纪的欧洲，亨利与朱莉娅因战争相遇。两段跨越时代的爱情，共同揭开弗雷泽家族的过去。

items.title: 幸福之地
items.overview: 鲍比 (丽巴饰) 从她已故的父亲那里继承了一家餐馆，然后她得知自己必须与新发现的同父异母的妹妹共享所有权，两人之间产生了尴尬的紧张关系。

items.title: Newlyweds
items.overview: A later-in-life love story about a free-spirited woman and a buttoned-up professor who marry impetuously after a whirlwind courtship.

items.title: 雅嘎疑云
items.overview: 改编自凯特·桑德勒创作的同名舞台剧，并重新演绎巴巴雅嘎的民间传说。私家侦探拉普来到一座海滨小镇，调查大型渔业企业继承人亨利·朴的失踪案。随着调查深入，他与当地警探卡森及迷人的大学教授凯瑟琳发生冲突，并逐渐陷入充满神秘嫌疑人、隐秘生活与古老魔法的迷局。

items.title: 神秘科学剧院时刻
items.overview: 在不久的将来，乔尔·罗宾逊被福雷斯特博士和电视人弗兰克囚禁，被迫在“爱之卫星”上观看B级电影，他的机器人朋友坎博特、吉普赛、汤姆·塞尔沃和克劳·T·机器人将陪伴他观看。

items.title: The Young and the Restless
items.overview: The Young and the Restless revolves around the rivalries, romances, hopes and fears of the residents of the fictional Midwestern metropolis, Genoa City. The lives and loves of a wide variety of characters mingle through the generations, dominated by the Newman, Abbott, Chancellor, Baldwin and Winters families. ­ When The Young and the Restless premiered in 1973, it revolutionized the daytime drama. It continues to set the standard with strong characters, socially conscious storylines, romance and sensuality.

items.title: 大胆而美丽
items.overview: 持续的戏剧融合了浪漫与阴谋，背景是比佛利山庄和美国时尚产业的璀璨背景。

items.title: 综合医院
items.overview: General Hospital, which celebrated its golden anniversary on April 1, 2013, continues its tradition of passion, intrigue and adventure that takes place in the fictional town of Port Charles in upstate New York. The glamour and excitement of those who have come to find their destinies in this familiar seaport town intertwine with the lives, loves and fortunes of beloved, well-known faces. As always, love, danger and mind blowing plot twists continue to abound on General Hospital with contemporary storylines and unforgettable characters.

items.title: 我们的日子
items.overview: 本剧主要描述两个家庭：荷顿(Hortons)家族和布雷迪(Bradys)家族。 很多其他家族也进入到这个团队，并且偶尔露面。荷顿家族的女家长，Frances Reid从该剧成立以来一直参与演出直到2010年2月3日逝世。 Suzanne Rogers在我们的日子38周年庆生会中，回顾她第一次于1973年出场。 Susan Seaforth Hayes 则是唯一的从开播到现在都还在的角色。

items.title: 深夜食堂：东京故事
items.overview: 在一间朴实无华的日本餐厅中，几名食客因为对于特定菜品的钟情而建立了一种简单而深刻的心灵之交。

items.title: 大门之外
items.overview: 一个权势显赫的家族统治着一个豪华的封闭式社区，这里隐藏着诸多引人入胜的秘密和丑闻，等待着被揭开。

items.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
items.overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

items.title: 极道寿司次郎！
items.overview: 故事背景为近未来的洛杉矶，整座城市被“美食秩序”彻底掌控：顶级主厨的权势堪比黑帮大佬，餐厅就是各方势力的权力中心，为了拿下顶级餐厅的一席位，有人不惜突破底线，不同的烹饪理念更是分化出针锋相对的派系。

items.title: 斗破苍穹
items.overview:
萧炎曾是家族里公认的斗气天才，年仅11岁便已经抵达了常人穷尽一生都无法修炼到的境界。可12岁那年，一场意外让萧炎的全部努力都化为了乌有，失去一切的他体会到了人情的冷暖和世态的炎凉，之后，萧炎和纳兰嫣然许下了决斗的三年之约，来到魔兽山脉，在身世神秘的药老手下修炼。三年间，萧炎的身影穿梭在塔戈尔大沙漠和加玛帝国黑岩城等地，结识了云芝、小医仙等志同道合的好友，并且最终获得了强大的力量。三年一晃眼就过去了，萧炎毫无悬念的战胜了纳兰嫣然，却没想到，他的故事和劫难才刚刚开始。

剧情发展观看顺序：特别篇4（缘起篇）- 第一季 - 特别篇1（邂逅云芝篇）- 第二季 - 特别篇2（沙之澜歌）- 第三季 - 第四季 - 特别篇3（三年之约）- 第五季（年番）

items.title: Overgeared
items.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

items.title: 夜樱家的大作战
items.overview:
「这个家庭非比寻常！？」　

高中生「朝野太阳」，因为事故而痛失了家人，心灵也因此变得十分封闭。在班上的同学，大家对他的印象都是”超．内向”，唯一能够与之交谈的是他的青梅竹马「夜樱六美」，但是六美却有一个秘密！？

她的真实身份是代代相传的间谍家族的当家，还一直受到各种敌人性命的威胁。而且她的哥哥「凶一郎」是最凶狠的间谍，对六美表现出异常的溺爱。太阳发现，自己已经成为凶一郎“排除”的目标，生命岌岌可危…！

为了守护六美以及自己的性命安全，太阳采取的手段居然是与六美结婚，成为夜樱家的女婿！？

围绕着太阳、六美以及夜樱家前所未闻的「大作战」让人目不转睛！

items.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
items.overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

items.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
items.original_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
items.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

items.title: 仙逆
items.overview: 改编自耳根同名小说《仙逆》，讲述了乡村平凡少年王林以心中之感动，逆仙而修，求的不仅是长生，更多的是摆脱那背后的蝼蚁之身。他坚信道在人为，以平庸的资质踏入修真仙途，历经坎坷风雨，凭着其聪睿的心智，一步一步走向巅峰，凭一己之力，扬名修真界。

items.title: Where the Mask Ends
items.overview: Chou was once a lowly night-soil collector, bullied and mistreated by everyone around her. But her striking resemblance to Wei Rao, the daughter of a marquis, unexpectedly makes her the bride of Lu Zhuo, the heir to a duke's household, in a marriage arranged to bring him good fortune and save his life. Ambitious and determined to rise above her station, Chou sees the marriage as her chance to climb the social ladder. However, her critically ill husband suddenly awakens, and her assumption of another woman's place brings one disaster after another. Furious that Chou has taken her place, Wei Rao is desperate to get rid of her. Meanwhile, Lu Zhuo regards Chou as a vicious and scheming woman, constantly guarding against her and plotting against her. Beneath the seemingly harmonious facade of the duke's household lie countless traps and deadly schemes. Caught in the midst of these hidden conflicts, Chou struggles to navigate the competing interests around her while carefully planning her future. Determined to break free from the shackles of fate, she eventually uncovers the secrets of her own origins and reunites with her loved ones. Rising from a humble night-soil collector to a woman of status, she transforms her life and creates a brilliant future for herself.

items.title: Dive into You
items.overview: Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her. As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister's body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na's powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru's devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side. Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

items.title: Fool in Love
items.overview: Set in Bangkok, a rapidly rising commercial capital where money, power, fame, and resources intertwine on an elite stage, the story follows Ing, the eldest son of the Jian family — a proud, unruly, and stunningly beautiful business prodigy. His dazzling achievements fuel his half-brother's near-pathological jealousy. Yok is the second son of the Li family, bearing heavy family expectations. Gentle and exceptionally intelligent on the outside, he is a former reserve professional boxer weighed down by family pressure. After meeting Ing, Yok's suppressed self quietly awakens. The two are drawn into an intense dance of love and hatred.

items.title: 牧神记
items.overview: 主角秦牧，幼时被一女尸托举至涌江边并被司婆婆捡到，村长根据玉佩上的字为其取名为“秦牧”。被一只母牛哺乳长大，是天生凡体，但被村长骗为霸体，修炼霸体三丹功。后走出大墟闯荡，进入京城，拜入太学院。历经考验成为天魔教教主，并被延康国封为第一任太学博士。秦牧在延康国叛乱之战中引来魔神，掀起浩荡风云，后随武可汗入楼兰黄金宫，一个人打遍圣宫无敌手，麻翻无数大巫，盗走无数珍宝。后返回延康，助国师平叛、入京城斩杀太子、造射日神炮。秦牧得人皇传承成为新一代人皇。机缘巧合下遇到了亲生父亲，揭开了自己的身世，借助道门小玉京等人的帮助，开启了道法神通改革的大世。一步步逐渐成长，作为延康变法三杰之一，为芸芸众生而战。

items.overview: In the turbulent 1920s, Yu Changxuan and Ye Pingjun fall into a love-hate entanglement, defying war and fate together.

items.title: 辛普森一家
items.overview: 辛普森一家是来自美国普通的五口之家，荷马是春田镇核能工厂的安全检查员，母亲马芝曾经是一个很有思想的女性，自从嫁给荷马后渐渐地适应了主妇生活的定式。巴特是家中的长子，天性顽皮的巴特经常爱玩一些恶作剧，以至于经常惹麻烦。妹妹丽莎是一个很聪明的孩子，同时还是素食主义者，佛教徒，爵士乐。小女马姬是一个永远长不大的孩子。故事设定于虚构小镇春田镇，从许多角度对美国的文化与社会、人的条件和电视本身进行了幽默的嘲讽，经久不衰。

items.title: 法警小队
items.overview: 《黄石》衍生剧。凯西·达顿加入美国法警局精英小队，运用牛仔与海豹突击队员的双重技能，打击蒙大拿州的暴力犯罪。在守护家人与履行职责之间，他和队友必须面对执法工作的沉重代价。

items.title: 镀金时代
items.overview: 镀金时代是经济上经历剧变的时期，在新旧钱财来来去去之际，伴随而来的是日益严重的贫富不均。在这变化莫测的时代背景下，本故事始于1882年，年轻的玛丽安·布鲁克是联邦军将领之女，在父亲过世后成了孤儿并搬到纽约的爱格·凡瑞恩和艾达·布鲁克姑姑家。在她身边的还有位才华洋溢，名叫佩姬·史考特的黑人女性。玛丽安不经意地被卷入了姑姑与邻居的社交争斗中。前者是继承大量遗产的名门后代，后者则是坐拥巨额财富且冷酷无情的铁路大亨与其野心勃勃的妻子，乔治与宝莎·罗素。在这新旧交替之际，玛丽安是会循着旧传统的规矩，或是开创新的道路呢？

items.title: 寻踪者
items.overview: 改编自杰弗里·迪弗的畅销小说《The Never Game》。科尔特·肖是一名独行生存专家，游走各地寻找失踪者并领取悬赏。他凭借敏锐直觉、特殊技能和团队协助，调查危险案件、揭开隐藏真相，为陷入困境的人带来答案。

items.title: 动物管制官
items.overview:
《废柴联盟》男主Joel McHale将领衔FOX这部半小时工作地点单镜头喜剧。

本剧由《穆迪一家》主创Bob Fisher与Rob Greenberg，《全民追女王》编剧Dan Sterling共同打造。

顾名思义，本剧将围绕着一群负责动物管制官的日常工作和生活展开，所有人都在复杂的工作中认清了一个事实：动物是简单的，而人不是。

Joel将在剧中饰演“Frank”，一个固执、古怪的动物管制官，他或许没有上过大学，但仍然是房间里最博学的人。作为一名曾经的警员，Frank当时试图揭露自己部门的腐败事件缺最终导致他被解雇。这或许可以解释为什么他如此愤世嫉俗和脾气暴躁。在理解动物的方面，Frank展示了过人的能力；但面对同类…他或许不是那么精通。

《疯狂前女友》“Heather”Vella Lovell饰演“Emily”，一个招人喜欢、但偶尔也会有点迟钝尴尬的动物管制团队队长。尽管Emily偶尔在工作中不知所措，但她被自己的队员们深爱着。

《喜当爷》“Ravi”Ravi Patel饰演“Amit Patel”，也同样是团队中的一员；Amit是个不堪重负的居家型男人，承担的家庭责任超出了他的预期。他的搭档与他的生活方式截然不同，彼此可能来自不同的星球。

items.title: 梅格雷探案
items.overview: 《梅格雷探案》是由PBS制作的悬疑犯罪剧集，讲述本杰明·温赖特（《贝尔格莱维亚：新篇章》《指环王：洛希林之战》）饰演朱尔斯·梅格雷——巴黎精英警队“La Crim”的负责人，负责调查巴黎及其周边地区的重大犯罪案件。梅格雷是一位与众不同的年轻探员，渴望证明自己的能力。他调查时锲而不舍，拥有洞察罪犯心理的非凡直觉，以及对巴黎与其居民无与伦比的了解。

items.title: 美国人质
items.overview: 1970年代的印第安纳波利斯，电台新闻主管弗雷德·赫克曼被卷入一场人质危机。绑匪托尼·基里蒂斯劫持抵押贷款经纪人迪克·霍尔，并要求通过弗雷德的电台直播发声，一场人质事件随即演变成全国瞩目的媒体事件。

items.title: 金银岛
items.overview: 改编自罗伯特·路易斯·史蒂文森的经典冒险小说。年轻的吉姆·霍金斯和母亲贝斯得到一张传说中的海盗藏宝图，由此踏上横渡大西洋的致命航程。面对叛变、暴力与背叛，吉姆必须在危机四伏的旅途中成长，而这段经历也将彻底改变他的人生。

items.title: 心灵之地
items.overview: 在艾伯塔省山脚下弗莱明斯的牧场上，生活很艰难，在那里受虐待或被忽视的马匹在一个善良而勤奋的家庭中寻求庇护。 负债累累，银行即将取消抵押品赎回权。 他们可以保持牧场运转吗？

items.title: 格里姆斯堡
items.overview: 马文·弗洛特可能是有史以来最伟大的侦探，但他仍然无法解开一个谜团：他的家人，他将遵循每一条线索，与他从未停止过爱的前妻一起救赎自己。

items.title: 找春天
items.overview: 一名50岁离婚女子在寻找性爱与爱情的同时，还得照顾年迈多病的父母，以及抚养本该早已独立成年的儿子。

items.title: 高地迷踪
items.overview: 安迪·惠特福德， 拥有一半原住民血统的她， 为了躲避过往恩怨， 偕同妻子海伦与继女琦拉从墨尔本移居山区小城断脊镇， 接替退休警长山姆·戴森， 成为当地警局领头人。 在维多利亚高地的峰峦叠翠间，罪恶顺着蜿蜒山脊，汇聚成谜团。短短数年，有五人相继在浩瀚林海中消失，迟迟无解。 直到一场灭门惨案打破了宁静， 也为连环失踪案带来了转机。一张巨大的犯罪网络逐渐现形， 各色兽行轮番上演。 作为外乡人的安迪，秉持公义，对谜案进行抽丝剥茧。 让她始料未及的是， 随着调查深入， 连串秘辛使三口之家岌岌可危， 甚至自己的身世也跟案情有着千丝万缕的干系… 到头来，客非客， 主非主的安迪又该何去何从呢？

items.title: Universal Basic Guys
items.overview: In Universal Basic Guys brothers Mark and Hank Hoagies suddenly find themselves with no jobs when the Glantontown Hot Dog factory switches over to automation. Lucky for them, the town started a radical Universal Basic Income pilot program, giving all residents of Glantontown $3,000 per month with no strings attached. Now, Mark, Hank and the rest of their local buddies are once again kids in the summertime, overflowing with the perilous combo of free time and stupid ideas. This is a show about men trying to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed.

items.title: Crossroad Springs
items.overview: Crossroad Springs follows the Hamilton family, adult siblings James and Janet, their aging family members, dad, Willis, and Aunt Amy, who are eking out a living on Hamilton Ranch with financial hardships and staffing shortages. James, a pastor in Chicago, and Janet, an ER doctor in a neighboring town, feel called to return home to help the family. Once there, the siblings encounter the son of the owner of the neighboring farm, Daniel Newman, who are all wary of each other due to a generational feud between the families. As he settles into his new day-to-day life on the farm, James begins to realize there are no places to worship on the thousands of acres of farms. There, in the environment of come-as-you-are vibes, barns, rodeo arenas, even outdoors under clear night skies, James starts a cowboy church right there in the place where faith, family, and ranch life go hand in hand.

items.title: Hallmark Channel's Countdown to Christmas
items.overview: Kicking off at the end of October and running through Christmas, Countdown to Christmas is Hallmark Channel's annual holiday themed movies.

items.title: Against the Sky Supreme
items.overview: The former mighty Gods of the heavens, after ten thousand lifetimes of reincarnation tragically destroyed! The cruel curse, the hatred of ten thousand lives, Tan Yun determined, no longer sink! The most important thing is that you have to be able to get to the top of the world, step by step, stepping on the corpses of your enemies! To kill against the sky, across all the worlds, only I am the supreme!

items.title: FBI
items.overview: FBI is a fast-paced drama about the inner workings of the New York Field Office of the Federal Bureau of Investigation. These first-class agents, including Special Agent Maggie Bell and her partner, Special Agent Omar Adom 'OA' Zidan, bring all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep New York and the country safe.

items.title: CIA
items.overview: CIA centers on two unlikely partners — a fast-talking, rule-breaking loose cannon CIA case officer, and a by-the-book, seasoned and smart FBI agent who believes in the rule of law. When this odd couple are assigned to work out of CIA's New York Station, they must learn to work together to investigate cases and criminals posing threats on U.S. soil, finding that their differences may actually be their strength.

items.title: Murdoch Mysteries
items.overview: Set in Toronto at the dawn of the 20th century, Murdoch Mysteries is a one-hour drama series that explores the intriguing world of William Murdoch, a methodical and dashing detective who pioneers innovative forensic techniques to solve some of the city's most gruesome murders. Murdoch's colleagues include the love of his life, coroner and psychiatrist Dr. Julia Ogden, a staunch ally who shares the detective's fascination for science; Constable George Crabtree, Murdoch's eager but sometimes naïve right-hand man; Inspector Brackenreid, Murdoch's skeptical yet reluctantly supportive boss; and coroner Dr. Emily Grace, Dr. Ogden's protégé.

items.title: VisionQuest
items.overview: Vision, rebooted and having escaped from those who sought to weaponize him, has been in hiding. Searching for new meaning, he consults the AI personas embedded in his programming, including F.R.I.D.A.Y., E.D.I.T.H., J.A.R.V.I.S., and the infamous Ultron. His discreet existence ends when a bounty placed on his head thrusts him on the run with Thomas Shepard, a mysterious boy who may be Vision's son, reincarnate. As Vision evades capture, he must confront his nature, resist Ultron's influence, and unravel the enigma that is his young companion if he's to survive.

items.title: St. Denis Medical
items.overview: St. Denis Medical is a mockumentary about an underfunded, understaffed Oregon hospital where the dedicated doctors and nurses try their best to treat patients while maintaining their own sanity.

items.title: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
items.original_title: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
items.overview: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins focuses on a disgraced former football player, who is on a mission to rehabilitate his image.

items.title: Bass X Machina
items.overview: In a lawless Steampunk West overrun by brutal outlaws, machines, and supernatural terrors, a father is forced to become judge, jury, and executioner—knowing that every act of justice meant to protect his family may ultimately cost him the very people he's fighting to save.

items.title: Swallowed Star
items.overview: One day, an unexplained RR virus appeared on the earth, drawing the world into disaster. Infected animals mutated into terrible monsters, invaded massively, and humans built walls around the destruction and established the base city as the last bastion for humans. The suffering that mankind has experienced during this period of time is known as the "Great Nirvana Period." Not only that, Luo Feng not only carried the burden of supporting the family but also to protect the human homeland, for the better survival and development of mankind, together with other justice warriors, to join hands against the fierce monsters. Under the desperate situation of the end, can Luo Feng and other warriors repel monsters and successfully protect the human world?

items.title: 大门之外
items.overview: 一个权势显赫的家族统治着一个豪华的封闭式社区，这里隐藏着诸多引人入胜的秘密和丑闻，等待着被揭开。

items.title: Wan Jie Du Zun
items.overview: Lin Feng was gathering his martial soul in the Lin Mansion. He didn't want to. His fiancee Ji Manyao took the opportunity to take his martial soul, and he almost vomited blood and died. At the same time, Lin Feng's spirit entered the land of the burial of the gods. The mysterious woman in the land of the burials told Lin Feng that he could gain enormous martial arts power and knowledge by obliterating the ancient gods buried here.

items.title: Shrouding the Heavens
items.overview: The story took the nine dragons and the coffin as an introduction and brought out a huge world of primeval ages. Climbing the sky road, and singing songs, to see how Ye Fan shrouding the heavens.

items.title: Best Medicine
items.overview: In Best Medicine a brilliant surgeon leaves Boston to become a small-town doctor where he spent childhood summers. Despite his medical skills, his rude manner alienates locals as he battles hidden phobias and struggles with personal connections.

items.title: Doc
items.overview: Doc centers on the hard-charging, brilliant Dr. Amy Larsen, Chief of Internal and Family Medicine at Westside Hospital in Minneapolis. After a brain injury erases the last eight years of her life, Amy must navigate an unfamiliar world where she has no recollection of patients she's treated, colleagues she's crossed, the soulmate she divorced, the man she now loves and the tragedy that caused her to push everyone away. She can rely only on her estranged 17-year-old daughter, whom she remembers as a 9-year-old, and a handful of devoted friends, as she struggles to continue practicing medicine, despite having lost nearly a decade of knowledge and experience.

items.title: Reasonable Doubt
items.overview: In Reasonable Doubt, you'll judge Jax Stewart for her questionable ethics and wild interpretations of the law... until you're the one in trouble. Then you'll see her for what she is: the most brilliant and fearless defense attorney in Los Angeles who bucks the justice system at every chance she gets.

items.title: Phony
items.overview: Phony is a coming-of-age mystery about a teenager who wakes up in the hospital after a car accident to discover his mom - his only parent and his best friend - appears to have been replaced by an impostor.

items.title: Brothers
items.overview: Brothers is a heartfelt odd couple love story revolving around the strange and beautiful bond between Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson. Matthew and Woody's friendship is tested when their combined families attempt to live together on Matthew's ranch in Texas.

items.title: Stick
items.overview: Pryce Cahill is an over-the-hill, ex-pro golfer whose career was derailed prematurely 20 years ago. After the collapse of his marriage and getting fired from his job at an Indiana sporting goods store, Pryce hedges his bets, and future, entirely on a troubled 17-year-old golf phenom named Santi. Stick is a heartfelt, feel-good comedy about a found family and their relationships set within the world of golf as it's never been shown before.

items.title: Where's Wanda?
items.overview: Where's Wanda? tells the story of Dedo and Carlotta Klatt, who are desperate to locate their missing 17-year-old daughter Wanda, who disappeared months ago without a trace. When the police fail to find her, the family takes matters into their own hands, obtaining surveillance devices with the help of their tech-savvy son Ole. Disguising themselves as employees of an electrical company, they bug first their neighborhood and then half their suburb, finding out that behind closed doors none of their neighbors are who they pretend to be.

items.title: Reincarnated as a Sword
items.overview: Reincarnated as a sentient weapon with memories of his past life, but not his name, a magical sword saves a young beastgirl from a life of slavery. Fran, the cat-eared girl, becomes his wielder, and wants only to grow stronger, while the sword wants to know why he is here. Together, the strange duo's journey has only just begun!

items.title: The Greatest
items.overview: The Greatest intimately explores the incomparable life of Muhammad Ali. The amazing victories and defeats that made Ali a legend, both in and out of the ring, have been well documented and while those landmark events will live in The Greatest, the heartbeat of the story is fueled by all the moments that took place outside of the spotlight. The world remembers an icon, but The Greatest is about a man, a husband, a father, a brother, and a son.

items.title: Scrubs
items.overview: Old friends JD and Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time, learning that medicine has changed; interns have changed; but their bromance has stood the test of time.

items.title: Chicago Med
items.overview: An emotional thrill ride through the day-to-day chaos of the city's newest state-of-the-art trauma center and into the lives of the courageous doctors, nurses and staff who hold it all together. This is one of those days.

items.title: Abbott Elementary
items.overview: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. Though these incredible public servants may be outnumbered and underfunded, they love what they do — even if they don't love the school district's less-than-stellar attitude toward educating children.

items.title: Chicago Fire
items.overview: No job is more stressful, dangerous or exhilarating than those of the Firefighters, Rescue Squad and Paramedics of Chicago Firehouse 51. These are the courageous men and women who forge headfirst into danger when everyone else is running the other way and whose actions make the difference between life and death. These are their stories.

items.title: Chicago P.D.
items.overview: District 21 of the Chicago Police Department is made up of two distinctly different groups. There are the uniformed cops who patrol the beat and go head to head with the city's street crimes. And there's the Intelligence Unit, the team that combats the city's major offenses - organized crime, drug trafficking, high profile murders and beyond. These are their stories.

items.title: Black Doves
items.overview: Helen Webb, politician's wife, doting mother, and professional spy, has been passing on her husband's secrets to the Black Doves, the shadowy organization for whom she works. But when her lover Jason is assassinated, Helen's life is turned upside down, and only her old friend Sam Young can keep her safe. But Sam, a suave, champagne-drinking assassin, also has problems of his own. Out of the game, since his last job went wrong, he soon realizes his past is coming back to haunt him. Together, they set off on a mission that will lead them to uncover a vast, interconnected conspiracy. One that links the murky underworld of London to a looming geopolitical crisis — and leads them to question the cost of the moral choices they've made.

items.overview: The Lowdown follows the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.

items.overview: In this new iteration, Beavis and Butt-Head are entering a whole new Gen Z world. Comedy Central has ordered two seasons of the new series with meta-themes relatable to both new and old fans - Gen X parents and their Gen Z kids. Judge is set to write, produce and provide voice over for both iconic characters.

items.title: All's Fair
items.overview: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

items.overview: Georgie & Mandy's First Marriage follows Georgie and Mandy as they raise their young family in Texas while navigating the challenges of adulthood, parenting and marriage.

items.overview: 9-1-1 is a fast-paced exploration into the lives and careers of first responders – cops, paramedics, firefighters – the people who put their lives on the line to save others.

items.title: Law & Order: Special Victims Unit
items.overview: In the criminal justice system, sexually-based offenses are considered especially heinous. In New York City, the dedicated detectives who investigate these vicious felonies are members of an elite squad known as the Special Victims Unit. These are their stories.

items.title: Elsbeth
items.overview: Elsbeth follows Elsbeth Tascioni, an astute but unconventional attorney who utilizes her singular point of view to make unique observations and corner brilliant criminals alongside the NYPD. After leaving her successful legal career in Chicago to tackle a new investigative role in New York City, Elsbeth finds herself jockeying with the toast of the NYPD, Captain C.W. Wagner, a charismatic and revered leader. Working alongside Elsbeth is Officer Kaya Blanke, a stoic and ethical officer who quickly develops an appreciation for Elsbeth's insightful and offbeat ways.

items.title: Law & Order
items.overview: In the criminal justice system, the people are represented by two separate, yet equally important, groups: the police, who investigate crime; and the district attorneys, who prosecute the offenders. These are their stories.

items.title: Grey's Anatomy
items.overview: The doctors of Grey Sloan Memorial Hospital deal with life-or-death consequences on a daily basis -- it's in one another that they find comfort, friendship and, at times, more than friendship. Together they're discovering that neither medicine nor relationships can be defined in black and white. Real life only comes in shades of grey.

items.title: Tulsa King
items.overview: Tulsa King follows New York mafia capo Dwight "The General" Manfredi, just after he is released from prison after 25 years and unceremoniously exiled by his boss to set up shop in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Realizing that his mob family may not have his best interests in mind, Dwight slowly builds a "crew" from a group of unlikely characters, to help him establish a new criminal empire in a place that, to him, might as well be another planet.

items.title: MobLand
items.overview: With the most powerful clients in Europe, MobLand will see family fortunes and reputations at risk, odd alliances unfold, and betrayal around every corner; and while the family might be London's most elite fixers today, the nature of their business means there is no guarantee what's in store tomorrow.MobLand follows two generations of gangsters, the businesses they run, the complex relationships they weave and the man they call upon to fix their problem.

items.title: Dexter: Resurrection
items.overview: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realizes his past is catching up to him fast.

items.title: Eternally Yours
items.overview: Eternally Yours is a family comedy centered around Charles and Liz - a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they've settled into an eternal rut - until their daughter's earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever... or if forever is a life sentence.

items.title: War
items.overview: War follows two of London's most prestigious rival firms – Cathcarts and Taylor & Byrne – as they go head-to-head in the divorce case of the century. Each side is certain they'll win. But as the case spirals and loyalties fracture, reputations are on the line, and everyone's playing to win.
items.episode_title: The Simple Act of Paying Attention

items.title: 9-1-1: Nashville
items.overview: A high-octane procedural about heroic first responders, as well as their family saga of power and glamour set in one of America's most diverse and dynamic cities.

items.title: Cupertino
items.overview: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

items.title: Blue Skies
items.overview: Blue Skies is an all-new procedural series blending mystery, action, and emotional storytelling, centered on the powerful bond between a detective and her canine companion.Set in the stunning Crystal Ridge National Park, the series follows former military police officer Jodi Larsen as she returns to her hometown to serve as a criminal investigator for the National Park Police. As Jodi protects the park and its visitors from both natural and human threats, she navigates a new team, personal loss, and an unexpected partnership with Blue, a mischievous stray Labrador whose instincts prove invaluable in solving cases.The canine, Blue, a golden Labrador Retriever is played by three brothers, River, Comet and Canyon. River is considered the "star" of the three.

items.title: Nocturne
items.overview: Nocturne tells the story of Jonah Lynn, an ex-soldier turned homicide detective who, tired of working the tough streets of Philadelphia, moves to a small town in Western Pennsylvania for a quiet life. But, as the town and his family come under attack from the diabolically cunning serial killer Jurek Walter, Jonah must protect all that he holds dear. When the desperate search for Jurek's last missing victim forces Jonah to send his adopted daughter, FBI Agent Saga Bauer, up against Jurek, how far will Jonah go?

items.title: The Assassin
items.overview: Secluded on a remote Greek island, retired assassin Julie has a somewhat thorny reunion with her estranged son, Edward, visiting from England. Armed with questions around new information on his paternity, Edward battles to find the right time to speak to his frustratingly distant mother. But, when the moment finally presents itself, things take a deadly turn as Julie's dangerous past catches up with her and they are forced to flee the island and go on the run together.Edward's quest for truth clashes with Julie's secrecy whilst they are forced to work together in a fight for survival, testing their dysfunctional relationship to its limits. Amid uncovering a dark conspiracy they believe to be their only threat, a greater danger emerges that will destroy their relationship entirely. In a race against time, Julie fights to save Edward and salvage their relationship as past and present collide in a showdown across the globe…

items.title: 药屋少女的呢喃 第三季
items.overview:
In the aftermath of the Shi Clan’s rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district.

One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature.

Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation."

To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again.

From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: 萤火虫的出嫁
items.overview:
On the surface, Satoko has it all—she’s beautiful, the daughter of a nobleman, and at a prime age for marriage. Unfortunately, she is also quite ill and only has a short time left to live. Before she can secure a marriage that will redeem her worth in her family’s eyes, she finds herself the target of the mysterious assassin Shinpei, and her plans are put in jeopardy. In order to save herself, she makes a desperate proposal—of marriage! When it comes to love, however, Shinpei takes “until death do we part” seriously.

(Source: VIZ Media)

items.title: ジョジョの奇妙な冒険 スティール・ボール・ラン 2nd＆3rd STAGE
items.original_title: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken: Steel Ball Run - 2nd & 3rd STAGE
items.english_title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure 2nd - 3rd STAGE
items.overview:
In the 2nd STAGE, a desert crossing spanning roughly 750 miles- the land that Johnny Joestar and Gyro Zeppeli must challenge, is home to the area that is feared as the "Devil's Palm." In 1875, a threat lurking in said desert wiped out a cavalry of 26 people, eliciting fear from the local native people. As ominous incidents begin to unfold, they are forced to realize that this race is far more than a mere competition. The two press forward, where countless hidden motives collide..

(Source: Warner Bros. Japan Anime, Netflix Anime, edited)

items.title: サイバーパンク: エッジランナーズ2
items.overview:
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 pulls you back into Night City, where lives become entangled to the extreme. Weak, a washed-up cyberpunk legend, is now forced to live without chrome as he searches for a sense of purpose in a world that’s passed him by. Meanwhile, the deadly nomad D sets out on a path to revenge that brings him close to corpo secrets never meant to be found. Across this ten-episode standalone series, uncover a story of family, obsession, legacy — and how your lens reflects the stories of the people around you..

When the world is blinded by spectacle, what extremes do you have to go to make your story matter?
(Source: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Official Site, Official Twitter)

items.overview:
After battling in Kyoto and Nerima, the Rasetsu Academy students have grown stronger. But Yaoroshi leaves the academy to join the Oni Brigade for their "the total eradication of the Momotaro."

When Shiki realizes that they also target noncombatants, he sets out after Yaoroshi to bring him back. Meanwhile in Nikko, there's a research facility for horrific experiments atop the old Kegon Falls…

(Source: REMOW)

items.title: 冰之城墙 第二季
items.overview:
Koyuki, the isolated girl; Miki, the former school idol; Minato, the guy with no concept of personal space; and Youta, the gentle basketball player. Clumsy, frustrating, yet deeply endearing — this coming-of-age ensemble drama of crisscrossing hearts marches on.

As they grow closer, Koyuki and Minato begin to develop feelings for each other that go beyond mere friendship. Meanwhile, Youta finally confesses to Miki the feelings he's harbored for years. Some speak their hearts while others keep their emotions hidden, causing their paths — and their feelings for one another — to continuously cross and pass by… 

(Source: Netflix)

items.english_title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
items.overview:
Rein, an enchanter, is suddenly expelled from his guild one day. But instead of despairing, he declares, “Now I can do anything!” and begins reclaiming the massive number of enhancement points he once poured into his guildmates’ gear, setting off on a brand-new path as an adventurer.
Gathering around him are people carrying wounds that don’t fade easily: a genius adventurer who shut her heart after her party was slaughtered, a warrior who lost her family, and an assassin raised from childhood to kill. Yet Rein never rejects their pasts or their scars—he accepts them all with bright, straightforward warmth.
The stage is a unique fantasy world where Uzis, slingshots, and even yakuza exist side by side. But in this world, the more people rely on convenient technology, the more their magic weakens, and adventurers grow fragile.
Intelligent, vicious monsters roam freely, while in the underworld, outlaws bare their greed and ambition as schemes and betrayals intertwine. In a world where ideals and justice are easily crushed, adventurers fight on with nothing but their magic and their convictions.
This is the story of those who have lost their place in the world finding a new way to live. Rein and his companions’ wild, free-spirited second life begins now!
(Source: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Site)

items.title: 装备我最强
items.overview:
Sin Yeong-U (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game “Satisfy,” finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: “Pagma’s Successor.” He’s now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game’s most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

(Source: Tapas, edited)

items.title: 某暗部的少女共栖
items.overview:
This is a story of four girls living in the "Dark Side" of Academy City.

In Academy City where "ESP" has been recognized as a general science. Behind the peace, there is a Dark Side organization that undertakes missions that cannot be made public.

"ITEM" is an elite unit consisting of four girls. Takitsubo Rikou is able to read and track the AIM fields emitted by those with abilities. Frenda Seivelun, who excels in combat using explosives and traps.

Kinuhata Saiai, who can manipulate nitrogen at will and plays a defensive role. And one of the 7 Espers that Academy City is proud of: Mugino Shizuri. They live freely in the darkness of the Academy City, and quietly set their sights on their target...!

This is a story of encounter, friendship, and darkness that eventually leads to a terrible incident!

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

items.title: ブラッククローバー 第2期
items.overview:
As tyranny engulfs the Clover Kingdom, Asta and the Magic Knights launch a desperate raid on the Spade Kingdom to rescue their squad captains from the Dark Triad. But their mission leads them into a brutal battle against forces beyond anything they’ve ever faced. Now, Asta must rise above impossible odds to protect his friends and honor the promise he made to Yuno.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.overview:
Once dismissed as the sole ordinary student at the elite Arnold Academy of Sorcery, Ray White—secretly, the Iceblade Sorcerer—has finally earned his place. With a new school year comes a new challenge: The Magicks War, a grand competition pitting teams from rival schools against each other. But an ominous shadow looms over Ray and his friends as the other grand sorcerers plot their next moves.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: FX战士久留美
items.overview:
University student Kurumi Fukuga has finally fulfilled her long-held desire of starting foreign exchange (FX) trading, motivated by recouping the 20 million yen her late mother lost in trading. "I'll easily make it back," she thought, but the world she enters can become heaven or hell in an instant. Unrealized losses, loss-cutting, unstoppable fluctuations… but she still wants to buy, sell and make money! With fellow FX addicts Mochiko, Mebuki and Yasuko along for the ride, the market heats up! Joy, despair, joy, despair — this is an endearing, yet slightly risky money game. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this turbulent world?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.english_title: A Returner's Magic Should be Special Season 2
items.overview:
In a land dominated by the formidable Shadow Worlds, most of humanity has been destroyed. To rescue their planet from impending doom, six brave heroes fight a perilous battle…and fail. But there’s a glimpse of hope when Desir, one of the last mages, is suddenly sent back in time 13 years! Now armed with knowledge of the grim future, can he alter the course of history and save the world?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

items.title: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン
items.overview:
A great hero lies undefeated on her deathbed, regretting that she never found a foe who could take her down. She never intended to meet her fate anywhere other than on the battlefield, and her peaceful demise has her wishing desperately that things could have been different... But when she suddenly comes to in the body of the young, frail Nia Liston, she’s got an all-new fight ahead of her. Nia is a sickly child, meaning she has a long way to go before she’s in fighting form. Now that she’s been given a second shot at life, however, she’s determined to get what she wants. She’s going to live—and die—for battle this time! Make way for the Merciless Maiden!

(Source: J-Novel Club)

items.title: 世界最强的魔女，就此开始
items.overview:
After using her SSS-Rank skill, Internet, to crush her former family’s ambitions, Lorna is free to travel the world. Her next stop is the port town of Aquas, where she hopes to see the sights and chow down on some fresh seafood. But when she arrives, the place is on the brink of destruction thanks to a certain Weekly Quest… Good thing Lorna has the gods on her side!

(Source: Crunchyroll)

RPG player Makoto Takatsuki is hurled into another world with awful skills and stats. But he soon meets a goddess named Noah, who asks him to become her 1st believer in return for blessings.

items.english_title: Hello, I am a Witch and my Crush Wants me to Make a Love Potion!
items.overview:
“Make me a love potion.”

And with that single sentence, the Good Witch of the Lake’s secret crush on the dashing Sir Harij ends in heartbreak. Still, when he promises to help her gather the ingredients, Rose is thrilled at the chance to gaze upon a man she’d normally never get to interact with. She learns to brace her pounding heart for their usual stilted conversations…but what is she to do when he inexplicably shows up at her doorstep with bread and a jar of apple butter?

(Source: Yen Press)

items.title: 冷淡的佐藤同学只对我撒娇
items.original_title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
items.english_title: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
items.overview:
Sato-san is the unattainable flower of the class. She is always cold and curt with classmates, but only I know she's actually very cute when she smiles, even if she's not much of a photographer.

Oshio-kun is friendly and lively, but only I know he works at his family's cafe after school. He does a great job with the cafe's SNS account, and his mischievous smile makes my heart skip a beat!

Innocent and sweet, but sometimes frustrating, this is a 120%-pure fluffy story about two people falling in love for the first time.

items.original_title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
items.english_title: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes!
items.overview:
This is Fujinasu Academy, a private high school with top-achieving students located on the outskirts of town.

High School 1st-Year Ume Mizunoe has excellent grades in Japanese language class and has received multiple literary awards.
However, his terrible grades in the sciences are affecting his ability to move up a grade. To avoid repeating a year, he becomes a member of the student council to improve his academic standing.

However, in the student council, he meets the charismatic yet sullen student council president Kotobuki Hisako, and the scary yet kind and refined treasurer, Arisu Terui. Other members include a cheeky and cute boy, Tan Otori, and Komaro Michinoku, the admin who's like a small abandoned cat. This is the start of a slapstick, heartful, rom-com about a busy student council full of cute, mismatched, and quirky students!

(Source: Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! Official Site)

items.title: PSYREN -决战游戏-
items.overview:
One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious “red phone card” left behind in a public telephone booth.
A few days later, his childhood friend and classmate, Sakurako Amamiya—who possessed the same card—suddenly vanishes without a trace. In search of her, Ageha finds himself drawn into the rumors surrounding a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances, said to be the work of a secret organization known only as “Psyren.”
When he accesses the group, a deadly game begins—one that will change his fate forever.

(Source: PSYЯEN Official Site)

items.title: 龙珠超 比鲁斯
items.overview:

Even Kai and Supreme Kai, aware of Beerus's overwhelming power to destroy entire planets, watch his awakening with great fear… Meanwhile, Beerus hears rumors of a Saiyan who defeated Frieza—and suddenly appears before Goku.
Targeted by Beerus, the strongest being in the universe, Earth is in grave danger. Thus begins an earth-shattering cosmic battle between the God of Destruction and Goku and his alliesa—a conflict that will shake the entire universe.

(Source: Official Site)

Note: “Enhanced” edition of Dragon Ball Super, featuring a large volume of newly added and redrawn cuts, a reconstructed narrative, and updated visuals for a more immersive and faithful representation of Akira Toriyama’s original manga.

items.title: 转生后的大圣女，极力隐瞒圣女的身份

items.english_title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
items.overview:
Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she’s the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes…and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)
